info.title: Courtpit API
info.description:
Courtpit REST API.

**Community.** Every request is scoped to one community. Native clients send `X-Courtpit-Community: <slug>`; browsers are resolved from the host (`<slug>.courtpit.app` or a registered custom domain). The header wins over the host. A request without a resolvable community answers `400`, an unknown one `404`.

**Authentication.** A session is an opaque token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (native) or as the `courtpit_session` cookie (web; ask for it at sign-in with `X-Courtpit-Client: web`). Either one authenticates.

**Errors.** Every error is `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`; clients switch on `code`.

**Lists** are cursor-paginated: `?cursor=&limit=` in, `{ items, next_cursor }` out.

post.summary: Creates a league in `draft` (admin). Publish it to open registration.

patch.summary: Edits a league while it is still a draft (admin).

post.summary: Cancels a league that hasn't finished (admin). Its unplayed matches are cancelled too.

Finishes an active league whose `ends_at` has passed (admin). Without `force`, refuses
(409 `unresolved_matches`) while any match is still reported or disputed; before the end
date it refuses with 409 `season_not_over`. Unplayed matches are cancelled and the final
standings, season points and promotion/relegation are recorded, as the lifecycle job does.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description:
Finish even though matches are still reported or disputed; they are left out of the
final table.

post.summary: Pairs two solo doubles/mixed entries into one confirmed entry (admin, before the draw).

Makes a draft league public (admin). Registration opens at `registration_opens_at`
(immediately if that has passed); from then on the dates drive the lifecycle.

get.summary:
The league's matches that still lack a result: `reported` (waiting for the other side or
the auto-confirm deadline) and `disputed` (waiting for an admin). They block the season
from finishing; newest first.

post.summary:
Registers the caller. Singles entries are confirmed immediately; doubles and mixed
entries wait for the invited partner (or a pairing) as `pending_partner`.

Accepts a partner invitation; the entry is confirmed. Any solo entry of your own in the
league is withdrawn.
Declines a partner invitation. The entry stays pending for its creator.

Withdraws an entry: its players while registration is open, admins until the league
finishes (matches already scheduled stay; admins award walkovers).

get.summary:
Box tables computed from the league's confirmed, resolved and walkover matches (league
match points, then wins, set and game difference).
Lists open requests whose window hasn't ended, soonest window first.

parameters.name: discipline
parameters.description: Only requests of this discipline.

parameters.description: Only requests whose UTR band includes your UTR.

post.summary: Opens a call for players: others in the UTR band join until every slot is taken.
Withdraws an open request (its creator or an admin).

Takes a slot. Taking the last one fills the request and creates the match (status
`proposed`, with the creator proposing the start of the window when it is still ahead).
Gives a slot back while the request is still open.

Reports the score of a match that was played, whether or not a time was ever agreed
(`proposed` or `scheduled`); any open proposal is superseded. The other side then has the
community's confirmation window (default 3 days) to confirm or dispute; silence confirms.

get.summary: The signed-in player's account and full profile.

delete.summary:
Deletes the account: scrubs personal data from every membership (match history keeps an
anonymous "Deleted player"), removes identities, codes and sessions. Irreversible.

get.summary: Exports the account and all memberships across communities.

Theme stored in `communities.branding`; clients apply it at boot. Missing keys take their
defaults; unknown keys are ignored so newer branding doesn't break older instances.

ErrorBody.description: The JSON body of every error response.

ErrorDetail.description: Machine-readable code plus a human-readable message.

code.description:
Stable machine-readable code; clients switch on it. One of `bad_request` (400),
`validation_failed` (422), `unauthorized` and `invalid_credentials` (401), `forbidden`
(403), `not_found` (404), `conflict` (409), `rate_limited` (429) or `internal` (500).

message.description: Human-readable explanation; never contains internal details.
